name: Parties and defined names
text: This Agreement by and between Lovejoy, Inc., hereafter known as the Company, and Kamceo Industrial Products, Inc. P.O. Box 905 Valley Forge, PA 19482 Known as the Representative, is in accordance with, and subject to, the following:

name: 1. Authorized products
text: 1. 80/20 Dvd OOWY> The products which the Representative is authorized to sell are those items of power transmission equipment sold under the Lovejoy, Inc. name. The items are as specified in current and subsequent catalogs, bulletins, and other authorized publications of the Company.

name: 2. Competitive products
text: The Representative shall not, without the Company's wnitten consent, offer, promote or sell any product which is directly competitive with any product the Representative is to offer, promote or sell for the Company in accordance with the terms of this agreement

name: 3. Sales prices and order authority
text: All sales shal] be at prices and upon terms established by the Company, and it shall have the right, in its discretion, from time to time, to establish, change, alter or amend prices and other terms and conditions of sale. Representative shall not accept orders in the Company’s name or make price quotations or delivery promises without the Company's prior approval.

name: 4. Sales to Representative prohibited
text: No sales will be made to the Representative, nor to any firm, parmership, corporation or other business owned, in whole or in part by, or managed by said Representative.

name: 5. Sales policies
text: Said Representative agrees to abide and comply with all sales policies and operating regulations of the Company, and communicate same to Representative’s customers.

name: 6. Assigned territory
text: The Territory to which the Representative is assigned is as follows: States of Maryland, Delaware, the District of Columbia, and portions of Pennsylvania and New Jersey (see attached territory maps).

name: 7. Territory exclusivity
text: This territory is exclusive, with the following exceptions:

name: 7(a). Export sales
text: a) No commissions will be paid on export sales.

name: 7(b). Government sales
text: b) No commissions will be paid on Government contracts or on sales to those accounts classified as Government Accounts (Company Sales Territory 39).

name: 7(c). House Account sales
text: c) No commissions will be paid on House Account sales, The Company reserves the right to redefine these accounts. Addendum A attached shows a current roster of the aforementioned accounts in your territory.

name: 7(d). Labor and freight charges
text: d) No commissions will be paid on labor charges or freight charges.

name: 7. Territory order credit
text: The Representative shall be credited with all orders accepted by the Company from their ternitory, except as noted above, as long as this Agreement remains in force.

name: 8. Commission payment and adjustments
text: 8. Commissions due the Representative are payable based on invoices to the customer, and will be paid forty-five (45) days from the conclusion of the month in which shipment took place. If orders are returned to and accepted by the Company for credit, commissions paid or credited to the Representative for such orders shall be deducted from the amount of other commissions due, if that amount is sufficient, otherwise, commissions paid on such retummed-for-credit orders shall be refunded to the Company. Accounts listed for collection will be written off and commissions deducted. When collection is made, the Representative will receive commission based on the net amount collected.

name: 9. Initial commission rate
text: 9. Durning the initial six months of the agreement, the payable commission rate will be three percent (3%) of shipments to customers in the Representative’s terntory, except those customers as defined in Addendum A. Such commission rates are subject to change. In the event of such a change, the Representative shall be notified by Registered Mail at least 30 days prior to the effective date of such change. For further clarification, consult the attached “Windfall Commission Policy.”

name: 10. New-business commission
text: 10. All new business secured by the Representative and sold through Lovejoy during the initial six month period will result in an eight percent (8%) payable commission. The deterzaination of whether business generated in the aforementioned territory is considered to be new business will be determined solely by Lovejoy Management. Representative will keep John Est informed of all new business/projects that are being developed in order to validate it as new business, and to differentiate it from normal Lovejoy business.

name: 11. Post-initial commission rate
text: 11. Upon completion of the initial six months of the agreement, the payable commission rate for all business will change to five percent (5%), irrespective of whether the business is classified as new or existing business.

name: 12. Reduced account commissions
text: 12. The rate of commission for certain accounts may be reduced by mutual agreement between the Company and the Representative. These accounts, along with the corresponding payable commission, are included as Addendum B (if applicable to the Representative).

name: 13. Territory and split commissions
text: 13. Commissions will be paid on invoices to the customer to the Representative in whose ternitory the Purchase Order originates unless the Company is notified, in writing, by another Representative, that he is actively engaged in soliciting an order for a specific item, or items, from the same firm at another location, and that the Purchase Order will be issued from a location outside his assigned territory. In all such cases, the commission will be divided equally with no part being retained by the Company. For further clarification, consult the attached “Split Commission Policy.”

name: 14. Special commission rates
text: 14. The Company reserves the right to set special commission rates on specific orders and/or quotations, where the competitive situation, in the Company's judgment, makes such action appropriate.

name: 15. Credit and collection
text: 15. The Company reserves the nght at all times to reject any and all orders because of unsatisfactory credit rating of the purchaser. On sales to unrated new accounts, the Representative may be required to furnish local credit information and submit full information with orders. The Representative will also assist in the collection of past due accounts owed to the Company by customers located in said Representative's territory.

name: 16. Term, renewal, and termination
text: 16. This agreement shall commence and become effective January 1, 2004, and shall continue in force for a one (1) year period, and shall be automatically renewed for additional one (1) year periads thereafter unless terminated by written notice from either party to the other party not less than GB/EQ ADVd OOWY> éSTSES/eTs S@:-PT 6882/20/ Ta sixty (60) days prior to the end of the initial or any subsequent ope (1) year term. This Agreement may also be terminated: a) By the Company immediately upon written notice to the Representative by registered or certified mail if there is a change of fifty (50%) percent or more of the present ownership or control of the Representative’s business without Company's written consent. b) By the Representative immediately upon written notice to the Company by registered or certified mail in the event the Company sells substantially all of the assets of its business or there is a change of fifty (50%) percent or more of its present ownership, or it is toerged with another firm, corporation or business and the Company is not the surviving company. c) By either party: i. In the event of the other party’s unreasonable and repeated failure to perform the terms and conditions of this agreement, written notice of the fatlure is mailed to or served upon that party, the failure is not cured within thirty (30) days after receipt of such notice, and written notice of termination is mailed via certified or registered to, or served upon that party, or ii. Upon immediate written notice to the other party in the event that party has filed or has filed against it a petition in bankruptcy (which is not dismissed within thirty (30) days after it is filed) or that party makes an assignment for the benefit of creditors, or iii. By mutual woitten agreement.
